metadata.title: Cosmic Atlas tile set v2: streamable 3D octree tiles of open astronomical catalogues
metadata.description:
The tile set behind Cosmic Atlas, a browser 3D map of the universe. Each catalogue is converted to heliocentric Galactic Cartesian coordinates in parsecs and cut into an additive level-of-detail octree of small binary tiles (16-byte render records plus a 24-byte extension with the 16th and 84th percentile distances), so a browser can stream only what is on screen. Every node also carries the summed light of its subtree. The format is documented in docs/data-contract.md; the code that builds it is in the same repository.

This is the web build: for each octree layer it keeps the shallowest nodes in breadth-first order up to a size budget, so the deepest levels of the largest surveys are not included. Layers: DESI DR1 galaxies and quasars (15,140,002 in the full tree), SDSS DR17 (2,313,525 not in DESI), 6dFGS DR3 (86,804), 2dFGRS (146,845), 2MRS (43,463), Cosmicflows-4 (55,877), the Local Group (146) and Local Volume (868), star clusters from Hunt & Reffert 2023/24 and Baumgardt (7,181), a Gaia DR3 preview within 100 pc (67,537), the Edenhofer et al. 2024 3D dust map, MPC asteroid and comet elements, a CelesTrak satellite snapshot, and the small catalogues of the atlas (named stars, exoplanets, pulsars, black holes, nebulae and others), each with a PROVENANCE file.

Licence: the tiles are derived data and keep the terms of their sources. Gaia data are CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO, which makes this bundle non-commercial as a whole; DESI DR1 is CC BY 4.0; please cite each survey you use (see the PROVENANCE files and the repository README).
